How To Verify This Report Card

Go to makkobillischool.com/verify on any phone or computer, then either scan the QR code above with the on-page scanner or type in the code printed under it. The result appears immediately — no login needed.
ACCEPT as genuine only if the page shows "Document Authentic." This means the report card matches exactly what the school signed.
DO NOT ACCEPT if the page shows "Signature Invalidated" (the details were changed after signing), "Not Recognised" or "Code Expired" (the code is unknown, mistyped, or no longer valid). In any of these cases, contact Makko Billi School directly before relying on this document.
